lines: Aina's roundhouse kicks burst into the bodies of the demons one after the other.
You have a pretty face for someone so intense. I like a hot-blooded girl.
Well, once the demon qi runs its course, her thoughts and body will be dominated by lust.
The real fun begins at night. Do your best to resist until then.
The Succubus and Incubus calmly said their parting words and quickly flew off.
What's with them? They sure like to run their flaps.
Even though they're demons, Succubi and Incubi are different from Oni and Orcs...
While many demons resort to violence, Succubi and Incubi corrupt people with their charm.
I guess you could say... they have a fearsomeness that differs from an Oni or a Devildom Knight, who are skilled with arms.
I'd heard recently that they were making inroads into the human world and were building up influence with groups such as Nomad, who were cooperating with Gaiza.
Their true nature was still shrouded in mystery, but they were certainly beings to watch out for.
I see... Ya know yer stuff.
And you, you're a demon hunter, right? Was this your first time fighting an Incubus?
Aina's fighting skills had been more than enough for me to trust her story about being a hunter cooperating with the military.
I'd seen that she had been through her own share of difficulties, butー
Well ya see, my parents were killed by demons. I'm out to avenge 'em. I just happened to become a hunter along the way.
That's why I'm not too familiar with demons other than the types that kill.
Aina told her heavy story with indifference.
Her parents were murdered by demons... It was a story I had heard from time to time nowadays.
Not wanting to pry any further, I had only been able to nod along.
(Hey, this is no time to get gloomy! Right now we've got to do something about that demon qi as soon as possible.)
Metier, is there some way to remove the demon qi?
It's... not something I can do on my own...
But there must be something. Like in case a human employee accidentally ate the food here or something.
Hmmm, in those cases everyone just enjoys devouring that person and it's over... Oh, wait, come to think of it...
I think I heard that there's an annex building of the hotel that has a potion to release demon qi for VIPs...?
I'd figured there was no way they wouldn't have one. There's always an antidote prepared for any kind of poison.
That's great, we're saved! Yer a Succubus too, ain'tcha? Go get it for us!
I-I can't do that!  It's for VIP customers... It's not something I can get so easily.
I see. So what do we do now?
However, I'd seen a ray of light. With the way things had turned out, I wanted to get my hands on the medicine by any means necessary and catch those demons off guard, especially Lilim.
(Now, how do we get our hands on it?)
(Realistically, our combat capability amounts to Aina alone. Fighting's out of the question.)
(In which case, I'll want to get it without much fuss somehow, like through a tradeー)
I closed my eyes and started refining my strategy. Howeverー
Just barge in and take it! It's obvious, ain't it!?
My thoughts were interrupted by Aina's shouting.
That's impossible! The annex building is a villa exclusively for VIPs, it's heavily guarded!
She's right. We're in the middle of hostile territory, we have to keep it as low-key as possible...
No way! We ain't got time to beat around the bush!
If we don't get the medicine by tonight, um... y'know... that arousal will...
Aina had become red-faced and fidgety.
No, this was no time to think about things like that.
While we wasted time here, the demon qi was starting to invade our bodies.
We had to do something before our rationality was stolen and we were unable to move.
Metier let out a deep sigh.
I suppose it can't be helped. I share in some of the responsibility, so I'll guide you as far as I can go.
For now, let's just take a look at the site and figure out a plan of action... I'm counting on you, Metier.
We walked off toward the villa of the hotel's annex building, guided by Metier.
